title: sirt6-ibd-tak1: superseded analysis code for the SIRT6-inflammasome study (archived for the record, not for reuse)
description:
This release is archived for the historical record and must not be reused. Its results were withdrawn.

Analysis code, result tables, and figures for an earlier version of a study of SIRT6 and inflammasome-related transcripts in inflammatory bowel disease mucosa. Errors were subsequently identified in dataset attribution, condition mapping, integer coercion, biological-unit assignment, and anatomical matching. Most consequentially, GSE116222 (an epithelial-isolation experiment) was used as a multi-lineage deconvolution reference, and repeated biopsies from the same participant were analysed as independent observations.

The corrected analysis is released as version 2.0.0 in this same concept record. Cite that release, not this one, unless you are specifically referring to the superseded work.
